roles.identity: exact source, tree, artifact, and candidate passport roots

roles.identity: release transaction id, ordered lifecycle state, and retained evidence roots
roles.responsibility: preserve publish, retry, repair, finalization, and terminal occurrence order
requiredEvidence: transaction identity, prior/current state, and publication evidence roots
nonClaims: does not infer release success from intent or authority

roles.identity: repository, version, target ref, channel, and exact tag
roles.sourceAuthority: protected Buildchain release intent and target coordinates
roles.responsibility: retain which release outcome is being pursued and its terminal conditions
requiredEvidence: repository, version, target ref, exact tag, and terminal transaction state
nonClaims: does not authorize publication or prove material correctness

roles.identity: release candidate passport and qualifying gate aggregate roots

roles.responsibility: bind the source, platform, gate, controller, and provenance view used for publication

nonClaims: does not claim complete repository reality or grant publication authority

roles.identity: publication admission digest, protected environment, nonce, source, and validity interval
roles.sourceAuthority: Buildchain publication authority admission and provider protection boundary
roles.responsibility: bind who may publish which exact source and artifact within a short non-replayable interval
requiredEvidence: admission digest, environment, nonce, source, issued-at, and expires-at
nonClaims: does not prove publication, success, or residual side-effect cancellation

preconditions: candidate passport binds exact source and release material
transitions.effect: declare one release candidate without starting publication
evidence: candidate hash and exact source/tree coordinates

preconditions: current Atlas and unexpired publication Warrant bind the same source
transitions.effect: enter the existing release transaction lifecycle
evidence: prior/current state and exact transaction identity
residualRisks: external registry availability remains outside the Profile

preconditions: publication evidence validates and final refs match
transitions.effect: seal a completed release transaction without rewriting prior failures or retries
transitions.receipt: Buildchain release transaction plus publication evidence
evidence: registry readback, artifact digest, tag/ref evidence, and terminal transaction state
residualRisks: downstream propagation is a separate lifecycle

preconditions: published material exists but retained evidence is invalid or incomplete
transitions.effect: retain an explicit repair boundary rather than claiming completion
evidence: failed validation and exact transaction state
residualRisks: repair may require provider-side human action

preconditions: the exact release transaction is complete
transitions.effect: settle release intent separately from publication occurrence
evidence: target coordinates and terminal transaction state
residualRisks: product adoption remains outside release completion

preconditions: source, passport, gate, or controller binding no longer matches
transitions.effect: deny publication until a successor passport view is qualified
evidence: mismatched coordinate and prior candidate hash
residualRisks: provider state may change after observation

preconditions: the short admission interval has ended
transitions.effect: deny later publication without erasing the admission history
residualRisks: expiry does not undo an already admitted publication
